remarks: Seller has requested all offers to be submitted by Sunday the 11th by 4pm.  Virtually new following a complete 2024 redesign, this quality-built 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath modern Colonial was extensively rebuilt and expanded to offer three levels of thoughtfully designed living space and an open floor plan ideal for today's lifestyle. The first floor features a bright living and dining area, a custom kitchen with breakfast bar, and a family room with fireplace that opens to a private outdoor patio-perfect for indoor-outdoor entertaining. A separate laundry room adds everyday convenience. The second level is highlighted by a luxurious primary suite with a spa-like bathroom, including a soaking tub, separate shower, and walk-in closet, along with two additional bedrooms and a full hall bath. A bonus room on the upper level provides flexible space for a home office, gym, or playroom. This home offers peace of mind and exceptional comfort with all new mechanicals, electrical, HVAC, high-efficiency gas boiler, spray foam insulation, new Marvin windows, cedar shingle siding, PVC exterior trim, and architect-grade roof shingles. Ideally located just two blocks from the train station in the reimagined Noroton Heights section of Darien, you'll enjoy close proximity to Heights Crossing and Darien Commons developments that offering shopping, dining venues, including The Goddard School all set within one of the East Coast's most sought-after communities.
